gabe: heads-up: planning a tiny semver karaoke tonight in the breakroom after standup 

lina: will there be a judgy compiler as a judge?

marta: yes, and it only accepts versions sung in proper minor/pitude

gabe: setlist idea: \n- 'I Will Always Bump You' (patch version)\n- 'Minor Changes (They Keep Me Loving You)'\n- 'Breaking My Heart' (major key)

ci-bot: reminder: do not perform any live merges during karaoke. Last time CI sobbed.

lina: i'm bringing props: a microphone with three lights labeled major/minor/patch

marta: can we have a penalty for singing non-semver syllables? like timeout in the corner with a YAML lint

gabe: agreed. bonus points for correct dotted notation in the chorus

lina: dress code: mismatched socks and at least one semicolon accessory

marta: also someone please make a playlist called "Semver Anthems" and include the compiler heartbeat

ci-bot: note: playlist must pass lint: no ambiguous timestamps, no nested playlists

gabe: tl;dr: karaoke, snacks, gentle version shaming. 7pm. bring your best changelog voice.
